name: Unity
oneLiner: UTY is XSY's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on Avalanche: USDC deposits hedged by long AVAX spot and short perps, with a 7-day redemption unbonding.
collateral: USDC deposits hedged via delta-neutral pairing of long AVAX spot positions with short perpetual futures; yield generated from perpetual contract funding rates; custody via Ceffu & Copper Clearloop
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDC to mint UTY at 1:1; XSY maintains peg by delta-neutral hedging with long AVAX spot and short perpetual futures positions; users redeem UTY back to USDC after a 7-day unbonding period

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: UTY is XSY/YieldPoint's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on Avalanche: token mint/burn is restricted to the MANAGEMENT_SMART_CONTRACT_ROLE holder, while DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE controls that role and upgrades.

controls.label: UTY management smart contract role holder
controls.evidence: Avalanche source and live role reads show mint() and burn() are restricted to MANAGEMENT_SMART_CONTRACT_ROLE; hasRole confirmed this address holds that role.

controls.label: UTY DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE / owner
controls.evidence: owner() and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returned this address; DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can grant/revoke the management role and authorize upgrades.

review.evidence: XSY/YieldPoint docs describe Unity/UTY as a synthetic dollar; verified Avalanche source shows mint/burn restricted to MANAGEMENT_SMART_CONTRACT_ROLE, with live role reads resolving 0x9b9C...C77A as the management role holder and 0xA780...42F4 as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE/owner.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve whether the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA is controlled by a multisig, MPC, or other policy layer.
Confirm the precise custodian split and any attestation quorum behind issuance.
